description: Plans a walkable 2-4 stop night out around a place, using only venues DrinkedIn has validated against an official licence register or premises census, or the venue's own site, and books nothing. Free. Side effect: saves the planned route (public venue data only, 30 days) for its share link, returned as route.plan_url; the user's location is not saved. Input, most reliable first: a point as latitude and longitude; with no coordinates, a free-text street address or landmark in address, geocoded to one point and planned like coordinates (coordinates win if both are given); or a place name in city, with region or country, which plans only when it identifies one place. A typed address is sent to a public geocoding service (OpenStreetMap Nominatim), which ranks matches and does not confirm them; the reply's geocoded_as and geocoded_point say what it matched. A name several places share returns needs_input with labelled choices, each with a place_key for the next call; the tool does not pick between them. Optional: stops, max_walk_m, style, vibes (both listed by drinkedin_get_guide, which is not a required first call) and exclude_ids to swap a stop. Output: a status (planned, partial, needs_input or no_coverage), the ordered stops with name, address, kind of place and walking minutes, meaning and say_to_owner lines, next steps and notices. Walking times are estimates (straight line x 1.3). Opening hours and prices are not known and not asserted; each stop points to the venue for them (its own site when the stop has own_site). Plans are for adults of legal drinking age where they are, and no reply states an age as a number. A reply contains only the stops the tool returns, with no venues, details or place names from other sources.

address.description: Optional free text: a street address, a landmark or the name of an area, used only when no latitude and longitude are given. It is geocoded to one point and planned like coordinates. The address is sent to a public geocoding service (OpenStreetMap Nominatim) to find the point. The reply echoes geocoded_as and geocoded_point with the notice address_geocoded: a match is a ranking, not a confirmation. No match returns needs_input.

budget.description: Accepted but ignored: not used to filter or sort the route; prices are not known. The reply adds the notice budget_not_verifiable.

city.description: City name. With region or country it tells apart places that share the name.

country.description: Country name or code; narrows a name several places share.

exclude_ids.description: venue_id values to leave out, to swap a stop.

language.description: Reply language code, such as 'en'. Replies are in English; any other code is accepted, and a reply that reaches the route search then carries the notice language_fallback_en.

latitude.description: Latitude of the start point in decimal degrees, -90 to 90, sent with longitude. A point needs no lookup and wins over address, city and place_key. A value out of range, or a latitude without a longitude, returns needs_input.

longitude.description: Longitude of the start point in decimal degrees, -180 to 180, sent with latitude. A value out of range, or a longitude without a latitude, returns needs_input.

max_walk_m.description: Longest walk allowed for each leg, in metres, the walk from the start to the first stop included; walking distance is estimated as the straight line x 1.3. 200 to 2000. Default 900, or the style's own default when a style is given (listed by drinkedin_get_guide). A value outside the range is clamped to it.

near.description: A label for what the point stands for, e.g. 'near me' or an area name. Echoed back as the route's 'near_as_given'; it is the caller's label, not DrinkedIn's, and does not change the plan.

party_size.description: Informational only: does not change the route.

place_key.description: From a needs_input answer: names exactly one of its choices.

region.description: State or province, a name or a code such as a two-letter US state code; narrows a name several places share.

start_time.description: Local HH:MM. Informational only: does not change the route.

stops.description: Number of stops wanted, 2 to 4. Default 3, or the style's own default when a style is given (listed by drinkedin_get_guide). A value outside the range is clamped to it. When too few validated venues are within walking distance the reply is partial, with fewer stops.

style.description: Optional route shape, from the styles in drinkedin_get_guide. It limits which kinds of place the route uses and sets the default stops and walking limit; explicit stops and max_walk_m win. It says nothing about hours, prices or atmosphere. Too few matching venues gives partial or no_coverage, not other kinds of place. The reply echoes style_applied.

vibes.description: From drinkedin_get_guide. Vibes we cannot verify yet are noted, not applied.

name: drinkedin_plan_night_out

outputSchema.description: The plan reply. status and meta are always present; the other fields depend on the status.

choices.description: On needs_input: labelled choices (places, styles or vibes).

coverage.description: How many validated venues are around the start.

geocoded_point.description: The point a typed address was geocoded to.

largest_places.description: Some places with validated venues; not a ranking.

meaning.description: What the result means, for the assistant.

meta.description: Versions of the tool and of the drinkedin-night-out skill these replies suit, and the server's docs page.

next.description: Ready follow-up calls: tool, why and args.

notices.description: Notice codes, such as legal_drinking_age and hours_unverified.

retry_after_seconds.description: On an error reply when the planner is busy: seconds to wait.

route.description: On planned and partial: the ordered stops and the walks between them.

stops.description: The stops in order: name, address, kind of place, walk, links, and hours and prices marked unverified.

say_to_owner.description: A plain sentence for the person.

status.description: planned, partial (fewer stops than asked), needs_input, no_coverage, or error (a fault on DrinkedIn's side, flagged isError).

style_applied.description: The style id the route follows.

title: Plan a night out
